beforeManifest.name: Cream puff-sleeve blouse
beforeManifest.provenance: Original painted eight-pose cream blouse donors and six complete rose skirt sprites made using OpenAI image generation. Exact prompts, source art, SHA256 values and cloth-only masks are saved in artwork/kling-side-expansion/female/source. Generated heads, skin, shoes and background are discarded. Complete skirts were repainted as isolated cloth to replace donor-hand occlusions with continuous painted folds. Separate cloth-only masks are fitted offline to each frozen source pose, with original source head/hands and uncovered body retained exactly. A coherent painted skirt donor is retained for each full action (idle/walk/run 0, jump 79), with continuous source-guided cloth scale/shear. Blouse frames40 and47 use adjacent backward-arm cloth to remove isolated sleeve/collar jumps. No runtime body deformation, frame interpolation or AI. Follow-up: near puff sleeve and cuff isolated from the existing forward donor and fitted independently through all 18 running poses. Original source arm released from erroneous local cloth ownership, existing torso/neckline fit retained. No new painted body, source warp, retiming, registration change or runtime AI. Reproduce with scripts/polish-kling-side-female-sleeves.py. Coverage review: source-bound original-cloth-only copy map closes false hand-protection gaps; actual source skin, hand ink, head, registration and motion are retained. See artwork/wardrobe-coverage/side/recipe.json; reproduce scripts/refine-side-cloth-coverage.py. This is local continuation of existing painted cloth, not newly extracted video layers.
